# stb_vorbis 1.22

Unmodified `stb_vorbis.c`, from nothings/stb commit
`1ee679ca2ef753a528db5ba6801e1067b40481b8`.
Source: https://github.com/nothings/stb/blob/1ee679ca2ef753a528db5ba6801e1067b40481b8/stb_vorbis.c

Use under Alternative A (MIT); full upstream dual-license text is retained in
LICENSE and the source footer. No build-time or app-time downloads.

The local wrapper accepts one complete CRC-checked Vorbis stream, mono/stereo,
8–192 kHz and a 32-bit frame count. Chained Ogg, Opus, very old Vorbis floor 0,
surround and corrupt/incomplete files are rejected rather than partly imported.

Vendored source SHA-256: `4c7cb2ff1f7011e9d67950446b7eb9ca044f2e464d76bfbb0b84dd2e23e65636`.
